custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations about the books the people want to read in the future.

initial_prompt: Create a conversation where roommates discuss what books they want to read in the nearest future and they share ideas and preferences with each other.

setting.conversation_style: Excited about all the fun that awaits in the world of fiction
